book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MADIU

content: Sises Mwohn Pailet
Ni eh rahnpeseng, samworo lapalap oh kaunen mehn Suhs ako koaros ahpw kapwungada re en kemehla Sises.
Irail eri salihedi, kahrehsang wasao, kahrehla pwe re en pangala rehn Pailet, mehn Rom me Kepinahn wehio.
Sudas Lusiamala
Ni Sudas, ohl me pangala Siseso eh tehkadahr me Sises pakadeidahr oh e pahn kamakamala, e ahpw koluhkihla me e wiadahro, oh pwurekihla mwohni silper silihseko rehn samworo lapalap oh kaun ako,
oh ndaiong irail, “I dipadahr mehlel ni ei pangalahr aramas mwakelekel menet pwe en kamakamala.” A irail sapengki, “Mehnda reht, pein omw pwukoa men.”
Sudas eri koskihdi mwohni ko nan Tehnpas Sarawio oh kohkohla; e ahpw kohlahte lusiamala.
Samworo lapalap ako ahpw rikpene mwohni ko, nda, “Mwohni pwukat iei pweinen kamaramas, ihme atail kosonned akan keinepwihki kitail en dehr kihong nan wasahn nekinek en meirong en Tehnpas Sarawiet.”
Irail eri kapwungada duwen mwohni pwukat oh pwainkihda sahpw ehu me adaneki Sapwen Sounwia Dahl, pwehn wiahla wasahn seriden mehn liki kan.
Ihme wasao adanekihki “Sapwen Nta” sang ni ahnsowo kohdo lel rahnwet.
Eri, ahpw pil pweidahr dahme soukohp Seremaia kohpadahro, ni eh mahsanih, “Irail eri ale mwohni silper silihseko, uwen mwohni me aramas en Israel ko pwungkihda me re pahn pwainki ih,
re ahpw pwainkihda sapwen sounwia dahl, duwen me Kaun-o mahsanihong ie.”
Peidek kei me Wiawihong Sises
Sises eri ket mwohn Kepinao; a Kepinao ahpw wia peidek wet, “Ih komwi me en mehn Suhs akan ar Nanmwarki?” A Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Komwi me mahsanih.”
E ahpw sohte mwahn ketin sapeng samworo lapalap oh kaun ako me karakaraun likamw oh kedikedipa ih.
Iei me Pailet patohwankihong, “Komw sohte karonge soahng pwukat koaros me re kedikedipahkin komwi?”
Sises ahpw sohte mwahn sapeng; Kepinao eri pwonopwonkihda kowahlap.
Sises ketin Pakadeida pwe en Kamakamala
Ni ahnsoun Sarawien Pahsohpa koaros, Kepina kin epwehnki lapwadahng mehn Suhs akan emen tohnimweteng ko, mehmen me re men pilada.
Ni ahnsowo mie ohl loallap suwed men me inenen adsuwed, me wie sensel nan imweteng, ede Sises Parapas.
Eri, ni mehn Suhs ako ar pokonpene, Pailet ahpw idek rehrail, “Ihs me kumwail anahne I en lapwadohng kumwail rehn Sises Parapas oh Sises me adaneki Mesaia?”
E dehdehki mehlel me re pangala Sises reh pwehki ar peiriniong.
Nindokon Pailet eh mwomwohd nan eh wasahn kadeik, eh pwoudo ileklahng, ketihtihki, “Komw dehr wia mehkot ong ohl mwakelekel menen, pwe I lokoloklaudkiher pwohng nan ei ouraman.”
Samworo lapalap oh kaun ako ahpw pangepangeniki pokono pwe re en peki rehn Pailet en lapwadohng irail Parapas, a en kemehla Sises.
Kepinao eri idek rehrail, “Ihs rehra me kumwail anahne I en lapwadohng kumwail?” A irail sapengki, “Parapas!”
A Pailet pil idek, “A dahme I pahn wiahiong Sises me mwarenki Mesaia?” Irail koaros wiahkihteieu patohwanohng, “Komw kalohpwuwehla!”
A Pailet idek rehrail, “Pwe sapwung da me e wiahda?” Irail ahpw tapihada weriwer, ndinda, “Komw kalohpwuwehla!”

Ni Pailet eh pehmadahr me e sohte kak wia mehkot me en katokeiraildi, pwe moromorete me kak wiawi, e ahpw ale pihl oh omwiomw mwohrail, patohwanohng irail, “I sohte men pwukoahki mehlahn aramas menet; amwail pwukoa met!”
A pokono wiahkihteieu werkihda, “Ntahn ohlen en kohdi poht oh pohn nait seri kan!”
Pailet eri lapwadahng irail Parapas; a Sises e pangalahng irail pwe re en kalohpwuwehla mwurin eh ketin wowoki rehrail.
Sises Wiahla mehn Kepit rehn Sounpei kei
Nein kepina sounpei kei eri ale Sises oh kahluwalahng nan Tehnpas en kepinao, wasahn kadeik, sounpei koaros ahpw pokonpene oh kapilpene ih.
Re ahpw kapwuhrasang sapwellime likou oh uhd kalikawihkihda likou weitahta ieu.

Re ahpw pil pahda elen tek ehu oh kidahng pohn kadokenmei, oh kihong sokon pwoat nin lime maun; re ahpw kin kelehpwikihdi mwowe oh kepkepitki, ndinda, “Iheng, Maing, komw meid roson, Nanmwarkien mehn Suhs akan!”
Re ahpw kin kendipih oh ale sokono poakiheki kadokenmei.
Mwurin ar wiemwahlkihla, re ahpw kapwuhrasang nan likou weitahtao oh kapwuhrohng nan uhdahn sapwellime likou ko. Mwuhr, re ahpw kahluwaieilahng likin kahnimwo pwe re en kalohpwuwehla ie.
Sises ketin Lohpwuwala
Ni arail ketiket kohieisang nan kahnimwo, re kasaingedi ohlen Sairihni men, me adaneki Saimon; irail eri itonehng en kapaikada sapwellimen Sises lohpwuwo.
Irail eri lel wasa me adaneki “Kolkoda,” me wehwehki “Wasahn Tihn Moangen.”
Re ahpw kihong Sises wain doal edi katik wasao, pwe en ketiki; a mwurin eh ketin song ekis, e ahpw sohte ketin urahk.
Mwurin arail pasurediong nin lohpwuwo oh kalohpwuwehla, re usuhski sapwellime likou ko ihs me pahn ahneki, re ahpw nehkpeseng nanpwungarail.
Re ahpw mwohndiong wasao oh sinsile Sises.
Pohnangin kadokenmei nin lohpwuwo re pasurediong nting ehu me kawehwehda kahrepen eh kalohpwuwala. Ntingo ketihtihki, “Ih Sises met, Nanmwarkien mehn Suhs akan.”
Eri, re pil kalohpwuwehla loallap suwed riemen iang Sises, emen mi ni palimaun, a emen ni palimeing.
Aramas akan me kin keid wasao ahpw kin tuhtuwelek oh lahlahwe Sises, ndinda,
“Ih komwi me pahn kauwehla Tehnpas Sarawio oh pwurehng kauwada mwurin rahn siluh! Komw pein doareikomwihla, ma Sapwellimen Koht komwi! Komw keredihsang nin lohpwuwen!”
Pil duwehte samworo lapalap oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo oh kaun ako, iang kepikepitki, ndinda,
“E komourala ekei, a e sohte kak komourala pein ih. Kaidehn ih nanmwarkien Israel? A en keredihsang nin lohpwuwen, se ahpw pahn kamehlele!
E koapworopworkihla Koht; eri, Koht en ketin doarehla met, ma e kupwure ih; pwe e kahskier me dene Sapwellimen Koht ih.”
Pil loallap suwed ko me iang lohpwuwalahr, ira pil iangada lahlahwe Sises.
Sises ketin Pwoula
Nin souwas, rotorot ehu ahpw kipehdi sahpwo pwon, oh wie rotorotki erein awa siluh.
Kereniong kulok siluh mwurin souwas, Sises ahpw ketin kapitie laudida, mahsanih, “Eli, Eli, lama sapakdani?” me wehwehki, “Ei Koht, Ei Koht, dahme komw likidmeliekiniehla?”
Ekei aramas ako me kesikesihnen wasao ahpw rongada met, re ahpw nda, “E ekehker Elaisa!”
A emen irail pitipitte tenge lihmw ehu, kaduh nan wain pweitikitik ehu, kihong ni imwin ahlek pwoat oh song kidahng pwe en urahk.
A meteiko ndahng, “Keisang, kitail kilang mahs ma Elaisa pahn pwarodo doarehla!”
Sises ahpw pil pwurehng kapitie laudida, oh ketin kadarala ngene.
Kahdeng me pereh mwoahl sarawien nan Tehnpas Sarawio teipeseng sang powe lel pah. Sampah rerada, paipalap akan pwalpeseng,
sousou kei sarapeseng, oh paliwar en aramas sarawi tohto me melahr, re iasada.
Re ahpw kohsang nan ar sousou kan; oh mwurin Sises eh iasada, re ahpw pwarala nan Kahnimw Sarawio oh pwarohng aramas tohto.

Kaunen sounpei oh sounpei ko me iang sinsile Sises, ni ar pehmada sampah eh wie rerrer, oh kilangada soahng koaros me wiewiawiher, re inenen salohda, re ahpw ndinda, “Mehlelete memenet uhdahn Sapwellimen Koht!”
Lih tohto pil iang mi wasao, me iang kilikilang mehkan me wiewiawi, ahpw re mi wasa me ekis dohsang wasao; iei irail ko me idawehndo Sises sang Kalili oh kin papah.
Eri, Mery mehn Makdala, Mery inen Seims oh Sosep, oh inen nein Sepedi pwutak ko, me iang mi rehn lih ako.
Ereksohn Sises Nekinekdiong nan Sousou
Nin soutikpene, ohl kepwehpwe men ahpw kohsang Arimadea, ede Sosep, e pil tohnpadahk en Sises men.
Ih eri patohla rehn Pailet oh pekihda ereksohn Siseso, Pailet eri mahsanih ereksowo en kohieng Sosep.
Sosep eri ale, oh kidimkipene likou linen kapw oh mwakelekel ehu,
e ahpw nekidediong nan pein eh sousou, me e ahpwtehn wiahda nan paip ehu. Ih eri katapwurehiong lapalahn takai ehu ni ewen sousowo oh patopatohsang.
Mery mehn Makdala oh Mery teio, ira iang mi wasao mwomwohd sallahng sousowo.
Silepe kei nin Sousowo
Mandahn rahno—me iei rahnen Sapad—samworo lapalap ako oh Parisi ko ahpw pokonpene rehn Pailet
oh ndaiong, “Maing, se tamanda duwen mwersuwed meno eh ketihtihki, ni eh momouro, ‘I pahn pwurehng mourda mwurin rahn siluh.’

Eri, komw ketin mahsanih pwe re en sinsile sousowo lel ni kesiluhwen rahn, pwe nah tohnpadahk ko de kohla pirapahsang oh ndahng aramas akan me ‘E iasadasangehr mehla.’ Pwe piht wet pahn suwedsang mehn mahso.”
Pailet eri mahsanihong irail, “Ien silepe kan, kumwail kohwei oh silehdi mwahu sousowo duwen amwail kak.”
Irail eri kohkohieila oh katengehdi takaien sousowo oh kihdi silepe kei pwe re en sinsile.
